items.headline: Brighton prepare for Carabao Cup clash with Manchester United
items.summary: Manchester United face Brighton in the Carabao Cup. Carlos Baleba trains at Carrington after recent ankle issue.

items.headline: Michael Carrick addresses upcoming fixture; Carlos Baleba progressing
items.summary: Manager discusses Brighton preparation at press conference; new signing Baleba continuing recovery from ankle injury to be available soon.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel seeks to leave Manchester United with top European clubs circling
items.summary: Academy prospect JJ Gabriel has requested departure; Real Madrid and European clubs monitoring as his 16th birthday approaches.
